scheme_name: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Family Pension
other_conditions: Applicant must be an unorganized worker employed in the operation of commercial vehicles such as cars, taxis, luxury taxis, light commercial vehicles, vans, auto‑rickshaws, tempos, lorries, trucks, or buses
The applicant’s vehicle must be used for commercial purposes and not solely for personal or family use
A nominee/dependent of a beneficiary is entitled to the benefits
benefits_summary: Monthly family pension equal to 50% of the beneficiary’s last drawn amount.
